subject: general
question: The simple interest on a certain sum for 7(2)/(3) years at the rate of 9.6% per annum is Rs. 6,624. What will be the amount payable on the same sum at the rate of 2.8% per annum simple interest in 9(2)/(3) years?
solution:
**Given:**

Simple Interest (SI) = ₹6,624

Time (t) = 7(2)/(3) years = 23/3 years

Rate (r) = 9.6% per annum

**Formula used:**

SI = (P × r × t) / 100

Amount (A) = Principal (P) + Simple Interest (SI)

**Calculation:**

₹6,624 = (P × 9.6 × 23) / 300

⇒ P = (₹6,624 × 300) / (9.6 × 23)

⇒ P = ₹6,624 × 300 / 220.8

⇒ P = ₹9,000

Simple Interest (SI) in the second case:

SI = (₹9,000 × 2.8 × 29/3) / 100

⇒ SI = (₹9,000 × 2.8 × 29) / 300

⇒ SI = ₹9,000 × 81.2 / 300

⇒ SI = ₹2,436

A = P + SI

⇒ A = ₹9,000 + ₹2,436

⇒ A = ₹11,436

**&there
4; The correct answer is option (3): ₹11,436.**
